docs.text: This is my about page Assalam-o-Alaikum! 🇵🇰 I'm a passionate Data Scientist at Codanics — and guess what? I'm also the founder! 🚀 👨‍💻 My Journey From the bustling streets of Pakistan to the world of data, I've been on a mission to turn numbers into stories. Whether it's crunching datasets or building machine learning models, I love adding a little Pakistani tarka to every project! 🏆 What I Do 📊 Data Analysis with a desi twist 🤖 Machine Learning & AI 🧠 Solving real-world problems 💡 Innovating at Codanics 🌶️ My Tarka I believe in mixing creativity, hard work, and a dash of chai ☕ to make data science fun and impactful. If you're looking for someone who brings energy, ideas, and a bit of Pakistani spice to the table, you're in the right place! 📫 Let's Connect! Feel free to reach out — let's make data delicious together! 😄
